{{Quote|Excuse me, captain. But I think "our object" just realized that we're tracking it.|Unidentified lieutenant to [[Unidentified captain (Endor)|captain]]|<ref name="ce1" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as a '''lieutenant''' aboard the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the ''Endor'' went on a patrol near the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]] and intercepted two [[TIE/sr starfighter]]s. They followed the starfighters until an [[Unidentified ensign|ensign]] detected large energy spike coming from the planetoid and warned the [[Unidentified captain (Endor)|captain]], who then realized the [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|trap]] and ordered a withdrawal. The order came too late as the ''Endor'' was destroyed by a single blast from the fully charged cannon.<ref name="ce1" />
